name: Five Nuclei Datasets
description: 可以，压缩到 350 字符以内。建议直接填： > This repository contains five histopathology nuclei segmentation datasets used in our study: CPM-17, MoNuSeg, Kumar, CoNSeP, and our Pseudo-H&E (PD) dataset. The first four are public benchmarks, while PD is an unlabeled H&E dataset used for semi-supervised pretraining and pseudo-label generation.
